title: Exclude gain from simultaneous P104 frame changes at fixed contacts and boundaries for every concave rank price
body:
## Summary
Prove zero best paid saving across every admissible per-component frame choice on the exact #7481 native with contacts and boundaries fixed. The exact corridor reduction covers 96 variables, 77 factors and all 214 legal profiles; nine integer generators prove the full increasing-concave tariff statement. **No new kappa**; all five foundational assumptions remain.

## Verification
Two separate parsers and enumerators agree on every profile. Normal/optimized and read-only Git-free replays pass, including same-optimizer positive control, source/ownership rejection and the complete 17-call T/P invoice. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; source #7481 head `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b`.

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-contact-recharting-bound
```

## Scope and credit
Extends the restricted domains in #7454, #7458, #7459 and #7453; retains #7481 and #7122/#7277 lineage. Changed contacts, productive boundaries, histories and frame grammar remain open. Prepared for Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance and separate algorithmic review; no human or formal acceptance claimed.

[Full proof, novelty, checks, limitations and credits](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/blob/88665d52c614eb1b33c8b78aa7e35f90d68e4ff5/research/complex-contact-recharting-bound/PR-DESCRIPTION.md).
